sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, section 1.1 (Renewal theory for cast + auto timing schedules)
sources_quoted.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`). With `c_i` the effective cooldown of ability `i`, the cast epochs of a solo ability are `0, c_i, 2c_i, ...` - again a deterministic renewal schedule; the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.

independent_computation.what_the_leaf_is: cast_timeline[4] is the 5th (0-indexed) cast event on the fight's shared cast timeline; 'ordinal' is the 1-based count of casts of that timeline slot so far (first cast of a slot => 1, a recast => >= 2).

step_1_effective_cooldowns.Q_Dark_Sphere: base 7 s at every rank, affectedByCdr = false, so generic ability haste does NOT apply. The only haste it receives is R's passive (10/20/30 by R rank): R1 -> 7*100/110 = 6.364 s, R2 -> 7*100/120 = 5.833 s, R3 -> 7*100/130 = 5.385 s.
step_1_effective_cooldowns.W_Force_of_Will: 8 s at rank 5 (12/11/10/9/8), CDR-affected: 8 s at 0 haste, 5.0 s at 60 haste.
step_1_effective_cooldowns.E_Scatter_the_Weak: 15 s flat, CDR-affected: 15 s at 0 haste, 9.375 s at 60 haste.
step_1_effective_cooldowns.conclusion: No Syndra ability can repeat earlier than ~5.0-5.4 s into the fight under any plausible haste for this scenario.

step_2_opening_block.cast_times: Q 'none' (0 s), W 'none' (0 s), E 0.25 s, R 0.25 s (all sourced from data/champions.json).
step_2_opening_block.shared_timeline_rule: math-foundations 1.1: mutual exclusion only; a cast starts as soon as its cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress.
step_2_opening_block.result: Every slot that is off cooldown at t = 0 fires inside the first ~0.5 s (0 + 0 + 0.25 + 0.25). Therefore the timeline necessarily begins with one first-cast event per castable slot, and only afterwards (>= ~5.4 s) can any recast appear.

step_3_how_many_castable_slots_syndra_ha.finding: Five, not four: Q, the second Dark Sphere charge (module slot Q2), W, E, R. The Q charge is sourced - 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2' - and the cached module audit records it as a real slot ('ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)', 'synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)', '40+ Q charges via Q2 slot'). The scenario's '60' sits above that 40-splinter threshold on Syndra's own threshold ladder (40 Q charge / 60 W true damage / 80 E / 100 R execute / 120 AP buff), and 60 is exactly the W-true-damage threshold.
step_3_how_many_castable_slots_syndra_ha.ordering_constraint_from_wiki: W 'grabs the nearest Dark Sphere' and E's full value comes from knocking a Dark Sphere ('Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units ... Targets hit are also stunned'), so any game-valid Syndra order must place a Dark Sphere cast before W/E. A four-entry permutation of Q,W,E,R is therefore either the default order itself or game-invalid - a 'custom order' scenario for Syndra is only meaningful if it encodes her real opener, which spends both Dark Sphere charges (Q, Q2, W, E, R).

independent_computation.step_4_index_4: With five castable slots, timeline indices 0..4 are the five first casts (all starting inside the first ~0.5 s, comfortably within the window), so cast_timeline[4] is the first cast of the fifth slot in the custom order and its ordinal is 1. The earliest event that could carry ordinal 2 is the first Q recast at 5.385 s (R rank 3), which lands at index 5 or later.

why_the_old_value_is_wrong: ordinal = 2 at index 4 is the signature of a four-slot timeline (Q,W,E,R with no second Dark Sphere charge), where the 5th event is the earliest recast - Q at 7*100/130 = 5.385 s. That drops the sourced 40-splinter Dark Sphere charge (module slot Q2) out of the opener, and it makes the 'custom order' scenario indistinguishable from the default Q,W,E,R rotation, since the only game-valid four-entry Syndra order is Q-first anyway (W must grab an existing Dark Sphere).
falsifier_stated_explicitly: This computation is decided by one structural fact I could not read directly from the permitted evidence tree: how many casts the scenario's custom order contains. If 'syndra_custom_order_60' declares only four casts (a permutation of Q,W,E,R with the Q2 charge disabled, i.e. splinters < 40), then index 4 is the Q recast at t = 5.385 s and the old value 2 would be correct. Everything else in the derivation (cooldowns, cast times, the shared-timeline rule, the 40-splinter charge) is sourced; only the length of the declared order is inferred. Anyone re-checking this leaf should read cast_timeline[4]'s slot/time alongside its ordinal: a time of ~0.25-0.5 s confirms 1, a time of ~5.4 s confirms 2.
boundaries_checked: both_wrong (ordinal 3+ at index 4) would require the custom order to list one ability three times before any other slot's first cast; Q's 5.385 s recast makes that a pathological order and nothing in the cached data suggests it - rejected.
Q's cooldown is explicitly affectedByCdr:false in the cache, so scenario ability haste cannot pull the first Q recast below 5.385 s; only R's passive (10/20/30) touches it.

Even at 60 ability haste, the fastest competing recast is W rank 5 at 8*100/160 = 5.0 s - still an order of magnitude later than the ~0.5 s opening block, so the 'first casts come first' conclusion is robust to the haste assumption.
